Symbol: CDSL ISIN: INE736A01011 Subject: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”). Dear Sir/Madam, Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 read with sub para (20) Para A Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations, we hereby inform that SEBI vide its order dated October 30, 2026, concerning the observations raised during inspection conducted by SEBI for FY 2023-24 imposed a penalty on Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL/the Company) amounting to ₹ 1,00,00,000/- (Rupees One Crore) pursuant to the provisions of Section 15HB of the SEBI Act, 1992 on account of observations relating to operational and Information Technology (IT) related matters.
